title: The small-town lawyer who has screwed Dallas. - NewsBreak
text:
By Tim Rogers ,
1 days ago The city of Dallas is short about $34 million and has pressed the “uh-oh” button, putting a freeze on hiring and any spending that isn’t mission critical. Also, Attorney General Ken Paxton is suing the city for not spending more money on cops. A big reason we’re in this spot—short on money, suffering the unwanted attention of a philandering pen thief—is an attorney named Art Martinez de Vara, mayor of a South Texas town called Von Ormy, population 1,100. He helped draft and lobby for the Dallas HERO ballot measures that require the city to spend more on cops and that allow people to sue the city if it doesn’t. The guy paying Martinez de Vara then and now? Hotelier and right-wing publisher Montgomery J. Bennett. Read full article
